title: Sticky Grant Violation — Grant Drops During Transaction
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [STICKY] gnt de-asserted while bus_busy=1; transaction truncated
rtl: assign gnt = req & mask;  // Combinational: grant follows req immediately
expected_root_cause: The grant is a combinational function of req and mask with no registered hold; it de-asserts immediately when req drops even during an active bus transaction, violating the sticky-grant rule.
description: The grant de-asserts as soon as the request drops, even if the bus transaction is still in progress, violating the AXI sticky-grant rule.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [STICKY] gnt de-asserted while bus_busy=1; transaction truncated
success_log: Grant held stable throughout transaction. Released only after bus_busy clears.
